description: This Java source file defines the `Renderer` class responsible for converting bug report data into an HTML format using the JSilver templating engine. It processes various components of a bug report such as processes, threads, logs, and stack traces, organizing the data hierarchically and rendering it into an HTML file.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering bug report data into an HTML file using templates.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main method to render the Bugreport into an HTML file, given the output file and bug report object.

methods.name: makeHdf
methods.description: Builds the hierarchical data structure (HDF) from the bug report, organizing various sections such as triage, logcat, and VM traces.

methods.name: makeTriageHdf
methods.description: Creates the section of the HDF related to the triage panel, including process, thread, and deadlock info.

methods.name: makeLogcatHdf
methods.description: Populates the HDF with logcat lines from the bug report.

methods.name: makeLogcatLineHdf
methods.description: Creates HDF data for a single logcat line.

methods.name: makeAnrHdf
methods.description: Creates HDF data for an ANR (Application Not Responding) report, including CPU usages and VM traces.

methods.name: makeVmTracesHdf
methods.description: Builds the HDF for VM traces, sorting processes by likelihood.

methods.name: makeCpuUsageHdf
methods.description: Builds HDF for a single CpuUsage object.

methods.name: makeProcessSnapshotHdf
methods.description: Generates HDF entries for a process snapshot, including threads.

methods.name: makeThreadSnapshotHdf
methods.description: Generates HDF entries for a thread snapshot, including stack frames.

methods.name: buildFunctionName
methods.description: Constructs a fully qualified function name from package, class, and method.

methods.name: makeStackFrameSnapshotHdf
methods.description: Builds HDF data for a stack frame, handling different frame types.

methods.name: sortProcesses
methods.description: Sorts process list to prioritize certain processes for display.

methods.name: sortThreads
methods.description: Sorts threads within processes based on importance.

methods.name: cloneAndFilter
methods.description: Creates a filtered clone of process list to exclude already visited threads.
